The '''Ookbat system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] and contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Ookbat/Legends|Ookbat]].
